mapper.update: update task set retry_count = retry_count + 1, state = case when retry_count + 1 >= 8 then 'manual_pending' else 'fail' end, next_retry_time = case when retry_count + 1 >= 8 then null else DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(3600, POW(2, retry_count)) SECOND) end, last_error = LEFT(#{lastError}, 512), update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.select: select user_id, topic, message_id, message, retry_count, next_retry_time, last_error from task where state in ('fail', 'create') and retry_count < 8 and (next_retry_time is null or next_retry_time <= NOW()) and (state = 'fail' or update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 SECOND)) order by case when state = 'fail' then 0 else 1 end, coalesce(next_retry_time, update_time), create_time, id limit 10
select count(*) from task where state in ('fail', 'create') and retry_count < 8
select TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, min(create_time), NOW()) from task where state in ('fail', 'create') and retry_count < 8
select count(*) from task where state = 'manual_pending'
